title: All I Hear Is the Deafening Silence
excerpt: A short thesis fragment about fear, ego, and the noise that remains after being broken down.

body.content: Looking back, I hear the teeth clattering beyond my years. My first year was shaped by confined fear and by the threat of what might happen to my ego if I let it show too much. My existence felt thwarted beyond recognition, broken down to the core of who I was trying to become.
